title: Internal Resistance and Terminal Potential Difference
body: A battery has an EMF of 24 V and an internal resistance of 0.5 ohm. When connected to an external circuit, a current of 4 A flows. Calculate: (a) the terminal potential difference across the battery, and (b) the power dissipated in the internal resistance.
source: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Electric Circuits
